stories.name_fr: Entreprises soutenant l’expansion d’Arm vers le silicium
stories.name_en: Companies supporting Arm's expansion into silicon
stories.explanation: Entreprises de l’écosystème (hyperscalers, cloud, mémoire, réseau, logiciel) citées comme soutiens de l’Arm AGI CPU.
stories.story_fr: Plus de 50 entreprises de premier plan soutiennent l’expansion d’Arm vers les produits en silicium, dont AWS, Google, Microsoft, NVIDIA et TSMC.
stories.story_en: More than 50 leading companies support Arm's expansion into silicon products, including AWS, Google, Microsoft, NVIDIA and TSMC.
stories.citation: More than 50 leading companies across hyperscale, cloud, silicon, memory, networking, software, system design and manufacturing are supporting the expansion of the Arm compute platform into silicon.

positionnement_ia.sujet: Arm AGI CPU, premier processeur conçu par Arm pour les centres de données d’IA
positionnement_ia.detail: processeur de production pour l’IA agentique, partenaire principal Meta
positionnement_ia.citation: the launch of the Arm AGI CPU , an Arm-designed CPU for AI data centers, built to address a rising class of agentic AI workloads.

Plus de 4x la capacité CPU actuelle par GW requise par les centres de données

sondes.citation: More than 50 leading companies across hyperscale, cloud, silicon, memory, networking, software, system design and manufacturing are supporting the expansion of the Arm compute platform into silicon.
The Arm AGI CPU delivers more than 2x performance per rack versus x86 CPUs, enabling up to $10B in CAPEX savings per GW of AI data center capacity*.
data centers are expected to require more than 4x the current CPU capacity per GW*
